questions.stem: What is the predicted formula of aluminium oxide, given that aluminium is in Group 3 and oxygen is in Group 6?
questions.explanation: Aluminium (Group 3) forms Al³⁺ ions and oxygen (Group 6) forms O²⁻ ions. To balance the charges, you need 2 aluminium ions (total +6) and 3 oxide ions (total -6), giving the formula Al₂O₃. The compound must be electrically neutral.
